                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರವೆಂದರೆ \"DGS-43\".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            இங்கே பின்பற்றப்படும் தர்க்கம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            எனவே, சரியான பதில் \" DGS-43\" ஆகும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "or": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ଏଠାରେ ଅନୁସରଣ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ତର୍କ ହେଉଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ଅତଏବ, ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି \"DGS-43\".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "as": "", "ks": "", "kok": "", "mni": "", "ne": "", "pa": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਇਸ ਲਈ, ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ ਹੈ \"DGS-43\".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\frac{{{{\\sin }^2}10^\\circ + {{\\sin }^2}20^\\circ +.......+ {{\\sin }^2}80^\\circ + {{\\sin }^2}90^\\circ }}{{{{\\cos }^2}20^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}40^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}50^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}70^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}45^\\circ }}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ସରଳ କରନ୍ତୁ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\frac{{{{\\sin }^2}10^\\circ + {{\\sin }^2}20^\\circ +.......+ {{\\sin }^2}80^\\circ + {{\\sin }^2}90^\\circ }}{{{{\\cos }^2}20^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}40^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}50^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}70^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}45^\\circ }}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "\\(\\frac{6}{5}\\)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "\\(\\frac{3}{4}\\)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "\\(\\frac{4}{3}\\)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ਸਰਲ ਕਰੋ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\frac{{{{\\sin }^2}10^\\circ + {{\\sin }^2}20^\\circ +.......+ {{\\sin }^2}80^\\circ + {{\\sin }^2}90^\\circ }}{{{{\\cos }^2}20^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}40^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}50^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}70^\\circ + {{\\cos }^2}45^\\circ }}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "\\(\\frac{6}{5}\\)"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "2"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "\\(\\frac{3}{4}\\)"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "\\(\\frac{4}{3}\\)"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Use trigonometric identities: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) and values of sine and cosine at specific angles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            sin θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Numerator,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Since \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            we know,  \\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Putting the values in (i),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Using the identity  \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Denominator,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Numerator/Denominator,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{5}{\\dfrac{5}{2}}\\) = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is 2. 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n22", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिकाओं का उपयोग: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) और विशिष्ट कोणों के sine और cosine के मान।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            sin θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            अंश,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            चूँकि, \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            हम जानते हैं, \\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            समीकरण (i) में मान रखने पर,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            सर्वसमिका \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\) का उपयोग करने पर,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            हर,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            अंश/हर,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{5}{\\dfrac{5}{2}}\\) = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ सही उत्तर 2 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n226:Tab4,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\", "te": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఉపయోగించిన ఫార్ములా:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            త్రికోణమితి గుర్తింపులను ఉపయోగించండి: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) మరియు నిర్దిష్ట కోణాల వద్ద సైన్ మరియు కొసైన్ విలువలు.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            పాపం θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            లెక్కింపు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సంఖ్యాకర్త,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\) కాబట్టి

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            మనకు తెలుసు, \\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            విలువలను (i) లో ఉంచడం,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\) గుర్తింపును ఉపయోగించి ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            హారం,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            సంఖ్య/హారం,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{5}{\\dfrac{5}{2}}\\) = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ సరైన సమాధానం 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n227:Tad6,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            पुढील त्रिक", "mr": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            पुढील त्रिकोणमिती समीकरण: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) आणि विशिष्ट कोनांसाठीचे sine व cosine मूल्ये वापरू.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            sin θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            अंश,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
