                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            जसे, \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            आपल्याला माहीत आहे की,  \\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            समीकरण (i) मध्ये मूल्ये ठेवल्यास,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            पुढील समीकरण वापरल्यास,  \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            छेद,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            अंश/छेद,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{5}{\\dfrac{5}{2}}\\) = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ 2 हे योग्य उत्तर आहे. 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n228:Ta2a,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\", "bn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            অনুসৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ত্রিকোণমিতির রাশি ব্যবহার করে: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) এবং নির্দিষ্ট কোণে সাইন এবং কোসাইনের মান।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            sin θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            লব,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            যেহেতু \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            আমরা জানি,\\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            (i) এ মান বসিয়ে,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\) ব্যবহার করে,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            হর,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            লব/হর,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{5}{\\dfrac{5}{2}}\\) = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ সঠিক উত্তর হল 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n229:Ta91,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + ", "ml": "", "gu": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            આપેલ છે:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ત્રિકોણમિતિની નિત્યસમનો ઉપયોગ કરો: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) અને ચોક્કસ ખૂણાઓ પર sine અને cosine ના મૂલ્યોનો ઉપયોગ કરો.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            sin θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            અંશ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            કારણ કે \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            આપણે જાણીએ છીએ કે, \\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            (i) માં મૂલ્યો મુકતા,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            નિત્યસમનો ઉપયોગ કરીને \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            છેદ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            અંશ/છેદ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\(\\dfrac{5}{\\dfrac{5}{2}}\\) = 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ સાચો જવાબ 2 છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n22a:Ta8e,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ ", "kn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\frac{{{\\sin^2}10^\\circ + {\\sin^2}20^\\circ + {\\sin^2}30^\\circ + {\\sin^2}40^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\sin^2}60^\\circ + {\\sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}80^\\circ + {\\sin^2}90^\\circ }}{{{\\cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ }} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ತ್ರಿಕೋನಮಿತಿಯ ಗುರುತುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ: \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1 \\) ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕೋನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಸೈನ್ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            sin θ = cos(90 - θ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಲವ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ + \\sin^2 90^\\circ\\) .....(i)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಏಕೆಂದರೆ \\( \\sin^2 90^\\circ = 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ನಮಗೆ ತಿಳಿದಿದೆ, \\(\\cos^2 70^\\circ = \\sin^2 20^\\circ , \\cos^2 50^\\circ = \\sin^2 40^\\circ, \\cos^2 40^\\circ = \\sin^2 50^\\circ, \\cos^2 10^\\circ = \\sin^2 80^\\circ\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            (i) ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಇರಿಸಿ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\(\\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 40^\\circ + \\cos^2 30^\\circ + \\cos^2 20^\\circ + \\cos^2 10^\\circ + 1\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಗುರುತನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ \\( \\sin^2 θ + \\cos^2 θ = 1\\),

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\( 1 + \\sin^2 10^\\circ + \\sin^2 20^\\circ + \\sin^2 30^\\circ + \\sin^2 40^\\circ + \\sin^2 50^\\circ + \\sin^2 60^\\circ + \\sin^2 70^\\circ + \\sin^2 80^\\circ = 5\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಭಾಜಕ,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({cos^2}20^\\circ + {\\cos^2}40^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + {\\cos^2}45^\\circ \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \\({sin^2}70^\\circ + {\\sin^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}50^\\circ + {\\cos^2}70^\\circ + \\frac{1}{2} = \\frac{5}{2}\\)
