                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The total number of students enrolled in the university = 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Percentage of students in the Medical stream = 15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Percentage of students in Engineering stream = 11%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Percentage of students in Law stream = 9%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Number of students in a stream = (Percentage of students in that stream / 100) × Total number of students

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Number of students in Medical stream = (15 / 100) × 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of students in Medical stream = 0.15 × 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of students in Medical stream = 2280

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Number of students in Engineering stream = (11 / 100) × 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of students in Engineering stream = 0.11 × 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of students in Engineering stream = 1672

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Number of students in Law stream = (9 / 100) × 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of students in Law stream = 0.09 × 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Number of students in Law stream = 1368

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Total number of students in Medical, Engineering, and Law streams taken together = 2280 + 1672 + 1368

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ Total number of students in Medical, Engineering, and Law streams taken together = 5320

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          విశ్వవిద్యాలయంలో చేరిన మొత్తం విద్యార్థుల సంఖ్య = 15200

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ఒక విభాగంలోని విద్యార్థుల సంఖ్య = (ఆ విభాగంలోని విద్యార్థుల శాతం / 100) x మొత్తం విద్యార్థుల సంఖ్య

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ⇒ మెడికల్ విభాగంలోని విద్యార్థుల సంఖ్య = 2280
